tasks.title: Complete meeting deletion lifecycle edges
tasks.description: Finish the typed continuity cleanup edges intentionally excluded from Private Preview 0.2.3 while preserving unrelated meetings, projects, and terminal verdicts.
tasks.details: Notion page 3c5f6cd22fd58151a2e3e2780052cae5 is the authority. Start from main@2246509 on codex/meeting-deletion-lifecycle-completion. Use e60c85de only as reviewed source evidence; do not blind cherry-pick. No fuzzy matching, transcript inference, direct JSON edits, user-project deletion smoke, external AI, MCP, or provider keys.
tasks.testStrategy: Focused unit regression and Debug build per coherent slice; Release isolation at the final engineering checkpoint. Defer broad suites and any destructive smoke until explicitly approved.

subtasks.title: Baseline main and selectively port e60c85de
subtasks.description: Compare main@2246509 with the excluded lifecycle checkpoint and recover only the still-required 60 percent implementation.
subtasks.details: Audit current deletion entry points, repository protocols, launch recovery wiring, project generation state, and tests before editing. Separate code already present on main from missing files and changes. Preserve unrelated dirty and untracked files. Commit and push the coherent baseline-port checkpoint after focused verification.
subtasks.testStrategy: Compile directly related targets, run the existing meeting deletion and transition repository tests, and run git diff --check.

subtasks.title: Close refusal object-reference orphans
subtasks.description: Remove cross-meeting refusal records whose currentObjectID or previousStateID points to canonical objects deleted with the meeting.
subtasks.details: Use exact UUID identity only. Preserve unrelated refusal records and their ordering/value semantics. Extend the pure deletion closure rather than hiding dangling cards in a read model.
subtasks.testStrategy: Add focused regressions for currentObjectID, previousStateID, and unrelated refusal preservation.

subtasks.title: Close ambiguity group and review object-reference orphans
subtasks.description: Remove cross-meeting ambiguity groups whose incomingObjectID or priorCandidateIDs points to deleted canonical objects, including their ambiguity reviews.
subtasks.details: Use typed UUID references. Remove the dependent group and its reviews atomically with the sidecar closure; preserve unrelated groups and reviews.
subtasks.testStrategy: Cover incomingObjectID, each priorCandidateIDs path, dependent ambiguityReviews, and unrelated value preservation.

subtasks.title: Connect deleteProject to continuity sidecar lifecycle
subtasks.description: Apply the established lifecycle contract when an entire project is deleted so its transition records and deletion intents do not remain orphaned.
subtasks.details: Reuse the existing typed closure and repository boundary. This is not a redesign of project deletion UX, cloud sync, tombstones, or audit storage. Other projects must remain untouched.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test project-scoped cleanup, other-project byte/value preservation, no-sidecar configuration, and repeated deletion.

subtasks.title: Prove durable deletion recovery and idempotency
subtasks.description: Finish crash and relaunch recovery across deletion intent, Project persistence, sidecar cleanup, intent clearing, and audio unlink ordering.
subtasks.details: Validate intent-after-write, Project-after-save, and sidecar-after-cleanup boundaries. Recovery must be finite, repeatable, and must not duplicate mutations. Keep intent payload privacy-safe: identifiers and timestamps only.
subtasks.testStrategy: Process or repository-level crash-point tests plus repeated recovery assertions and legacy sidecar decoding.

subtasks.title: Run focused verification and Release isolation
subtasks.description: Verify the completed lifecycle slice proportionally without reopening deferred broad validation.
subtasks.details: Run directly related suites, core regression assertions, Debug build, Release universal isolation, XcodeGen idempotency if project generation changed, and git diff --check. Record broad unit, Benchmark, full XCUITest, soak, and real deletion smoke as deferred unless separately approved.
subtasks.testStrategy: Produce exact pass, failure, skip, environment, and privacy counts; do not infer unrun gates.

subtasks.title: Synchronize Notion, Git, and review handoff
subtasks.description: Reconcile the Task Master graph with actual commits and evidence, then prepare the user approval boundary and next product agenda.
subtasks.details: Update the Notion Task with implementation result, issue briefing, deferred verification, branch commits and push state. Keep the Notion Task in progress until explicit user approval. Do not open or merge a PR, tag, release, or publish without separate approval.
subtasks.testStrategy: Re-fetch Notion, validate Task Master dependencies, verify clean tracked/staged Git state, and confirm unrelated untracked files remain preserved.

tasks.title: Establish development 16 human semantic gold
tasks.description: Create a human-reviewed development gold set for Meeting Execution without treating model suggestions as truth or exposing the sealed holdout.
tasks.details: Notion page 3baf6cd22fd581938839d70523e907dd is the authority. Work locally from codex/development-human-gold. The current review packet is not review-ready: current metadata says MEV0-001 is development and MEV0-004 is sealed_holdout, while the 16 model suggestions contain MEV0-004 and omit MEV0-001. Do not start semantic review until the partition and exposure contract are repaired. No external AI, provider key, MCP/server, corpus upload, sealed payload inspection, or product-code change without a later approved subtask order.
tasks.testStrategy: Use metadata-only partition checks first. Human-review progress requires explicit evidence gates, not Task Master completion counts. Validate gold schema, evidence references, unresolved count, independent second review, and deterministic scorer handoff before completion.

subtasks.title: Audit development split and review artifacts
subtasks.description: Compare source-index, manifest, model-suggestion files, validation report, and review packet without using sealed payload content.
subtasks.details: Read-only audit completed. source-index and manifest agree on 16 development and 8 sealed cases. Draft/report IDs are the stale pre-repair set: 15 current development IDs plus sealed MEV0-004, with development MEV0-001 missing. The old validation report's 16/16 pass proves only schema/evidence validity for that stale set. The existing review packet must not be used for human gold. A broad read-only search also traversed sealed case paths in this session; no files were changed or transmitted, but this session must not later act as the independent sealed-holdout reviewer.
subtasks.testStrategy: Assert metadata 16/8, exact manifest/index agreement, draft-vs-development set difference, sealed intersection, review-packet heading set, all current development gold statuses pending, and zero filesystem writes or network calls.

subtasks.title: Repair partition integrity and fail closed on exposed holdouts
subtasks.description: Make the development and sealed sets consistent with actual model exposure before any human review begins.
subtasks.details: Use metadata-only source selection. Every case that has a model suggestion or appeared in a review packet must be treated as exposed and cannot be sealed. Preserve 16 development and 8 truly unexposed sealed cases, choosing any replacement from the unused corpus by finite metadata strata only. Prefer a repair that preserves the current 16 draft IDs as development and replaces the extra exposed case with a new unexposed sealed candidate, but confirm selection invariants before editing. Add a fail-closed audit so draftIDs equal developmentIDs and draftIDs intersect sealedIDs is empty. Do not call a provider or read new sealed payloads.
subtasks.testStrategy: Prove deterministic 16/8 selection; source-index, manifest, case metadata, draft IDs, and packet headings agree; exposed IDs are never sealed; repeated generation is byte-stable; sealed payload read count is zero in metadata-only mode.

subtasks.title: Regenerate a development-only review packet
subtasks.description: Produce the authoritative local review packet only after partition integrity is proven.
subtasks.details: Build from the repaired 16 development IDs only. Keep AI suggestions labeled as non-gold. Include candidate verdicts, missing-item checks, direct utterance evidence, assignee basis, due-date basis, forbidden inference, and prior-state transition fields. Do not include sealed IDs or content.
subtasks.testStrategy: Packet headings equal the development ID set exactly; 16 cases; no sealed IDs; every suggestion has passed local evidence validation; generation is deterministic and local-only.

subtasks.title: Complete primary human review batch 1
subtasks.description: Review the first deterministic quarter of the repaired development set.
subtasks.details: Batch 1 is fixed to MEV0-004, MEV0-010, MEV0-014, and MEV0-019: one explicit-single-output, one multi-output, one negative-or-forbidden, and one assignee-or-due ambiguity case across social, education, economy, and life domains. DEVELOPMENT_REVIEW.md is read-only evidence. Record only the user's explicit semantic decisions in separate per-case primary-review JSON files; the generator may create a missing template but must never overwrite an existing review. A human must approve, modify, or reject every candidate and add omissions. Record direct utterance evidence, assignee and due-date basis, forbidden inferences, and prior-state expectations. The code agent may present and validate but must not decide semantic truth.
subtasks.testStrategy: All assigned cases have explicit candidate verdicts, missing-item completion, evidence references that exist in the case, and no unresolved fields hidden as defaults.

subtasks.title: Complete primary human review batch 2
subtasks.description: Review the second deterministic quarter of the repaired development set.
subtasks.details: Batch 2 is fixed to MEV0-005, MEV0-012, MEV0-015, and MEV0-023. Use the primary-review-v0.1 contract frozen after batch 1. Do not add or reinterpret fields silently. A discovered contract defect requires a new explicit schema version, a migration impact report for every completed review, and re-opening only cases that need new human semantic input; a lossless structural migration may be automated only when it creates no semantic default. Apply the same separate per-case primary-review JSON contract as batch 1. Do not tune prior decisions to improve a model score because no semantic scorer is authoritative yet.
subtasks.testStrategy: Same evidence and unresolved-field checks as batch 1; verify cumulative reviewed IDs are unique and development-only.

subtasks.title: Complete primary human review batch 3
subtasks.description: Review the third deterministic quarter of the repaired development set.
subtasks.details: Batch 3 is fixed to MEV0-006, MEV0-011, MEV0-016, and MEV0-018. Continue the same separate per-case primary-review JSON contract, preserving explicit ambiguity instead of forcing a false answer.
subtasks.testStrategy: Same evidence and unresolved-field checks as earlier batches; log ambiguity rather than converting it to an inferred gold label.

subtasks.title: Complete primary human review batch 4
subtasks.description: Review the final deterministic quarter of the repaired development set.
subtasks.details: Batch 4 is fixed to MEV0-007, MEV0-008, MEV0-020, and MEV0-024. Finish all 16 primary reviews in separate per-case JSON files and identify any remaining conflicts or missing contract fields before normalization.
subtasks.testStrategy: Exactly 16 unique development cases have primary human verdicts; sealed cases remain untouched; every case has four-category missing-item closure.

subtasks.title: Normalize and validate development gold
subtasks.description: Convert human decisions into typed gold artifacts and remove structural uncertainty without inventing semantic answers.
subtasks.details: Normalize the four result types, direct evidence references, assignee and due-date bases, forbidden inference, and expected prior-state transitions. Preserve explicit ambiguity. Validation must report unreviewed and unresolved structural fields separately from adjudicated ambiguity.
subtasks.testStrategy: Gold schema validation passes; 16/16 review status is human-reviewed; utterance references resolve; unreviewed count is zero; forbidden and ambiguity records remain finite and typed.

subtasks.title: Run independent second review and adjudication
subtasks.description: Have a reviewer independent from the primary pass identify disagreements and ambiguous cases before freezing gold.
subtasks.details: Paused as an explicit pilot after five completed cases: MEV0-004 through MEV0-008. Eleven cases remain in progress with 138 unresolved fields. The recorded blind guard counts are primary_reads 0, gold_draft_reads 0, primary_audit_reads 0, notion_reads 0, and network_calls 0. Do not claim session-level sealed_access 0: a recursive checkpoint search returned one split metadata line from at least one sealed case after the five reviews, and the exact access count was not instrumented. No sealed semantic content was shown, but this session is not eligible as an independent sealed evaluator. Resume at MEV0-010 only in a separately authorized review task. Do not compare, adjudicate, freeze gold, or score while this subtask is deferred.
subtasks.testStrategy: Every case has second-review provenance; disagreements are enumerated and adjudicated or explicitly ambiguous; no hidden overwrite of primary decisions.

subtasks.title: Freeze development gold and hand off to semantic scorer
subtasks.description: Version the reviewed development contract and prepare the next scorer task without opening the sealed holdout.
subtasks.details: Freeze development gold, review rules, provenance, ambiguity policy, and validation evidence. Synchronize Notion and Git evidence, but keep final Task completion behind user approval. The sealed holdout remains unopened until the semantic scorer and development rules are frozen.
subtasks.testStrategy: Re-run deterministic gold validation, verify provenance and rule version, confirm sealed payloads were not consumed, and prepare the scorer handoff with exact known limitations.

tasks.title: Implement gold-independent semantic scorer and regression report
tasks.description: Build deterministic scoring and regression-report infrastructure now, without waiting for unfinished secondary review and without consuming real development or sealed gold.
tasks.details: Notion page 3bbf6cd22fd5816f81dfd188dc3dc744 is the authority. Work on codex/semantic-scorer-regression-report from 5b5aeeb. Preserve the existing unscored PredictionArtifact and BenchmarkRunner semantics. The scorer must accept only an explicitly authorized, versioned scorer-ready gold input; all implementation and verification in this task use synthetic typed fixtures. Do not read human-reviews/primary, human-reviews/secondary, human-reviews/gold-draft, sealed payloads, or real development gold. Do not produce a development or holdout score, tune a prompt/model, call an external provider, or invent semantic equivalence with fuzzy text, keywords, or regex.
tasks.testStrategy: Use synthetic-only zero, perfect, miss, duplicate, over-inference, pending-gold, unauthorized-split, and deterministic-serialization fixtures. Run focused scorer and benchmark tests plus the directly affected app/CLI builds. Report exact numerator/denominator and unavailable states; defer real-corpus scoring until development gold is finalized and explicitly authorized.

subtasks.title: Audit prediction, gold, and report boundaries
subtasks.description: Trace the current unscored prediction pipeline and define the smallest scorer boundary before changing product or benchmark code.
subtasks.details: Read PredictionArtifact, BenchmarkRunner, BenchmarkCommandLine, BenchmarkCaseFile/Store, canonical gold schemas, and existing audio-scoring patterns. Identify which fields are stable typed identities and which require a future versioned human matching policy. Record the exact files and contracts that must remain unchanged. Do not open primary, secondary, gold-draft, sealed, or real case payloads. Stop and report if deterministic pairing cannot be defined without semantic inference.
subtasks.testStrategy: Read-only source audit, synthetic schema inspection, Git baseline, Task Master dependency validation, and explicit forbidden-path counters or static checks. No semantic corpus reads and no product-code mutation.

subtasks.title: Define versioned scorer input and authorization gate
subtasks.description: Add a separate typed scorer input that can represent confirmed gold without weakening the existing unscored artifact contract.
subtasks.details: Require an explicit schema version, scorer-ready status, development-only authorization, case identity, four typed output collections, evidence references, responsibility, assignee, due, forbidden-inference, and ambiguity policy fields. Pending, primary-normalized, secondary-in-progress, unknown-version, sealed, and missing-authorization inputs must fail closed before payload evaluation. Keep matching policy injected and versioned; do not provide a fuzzy default.
subtasks.testStrategy: Synthetic decoding and gate tests for authorized development input plus every refusal path. Assert existing PredictionArtifact bytes/schema and unscored reports remain unchanged.

subtasks.title: Implement deterministic output matching and accounting core
subtasks.description: Compute per-kind TP, FP, FN, and duplicate counts from explicit typed pairings without semantic guesswork.
subtasks.details: Score Decision, Action Item, Open Question, and Next Agenda separately. Consume exact canonical identities or an explicitly supplied versioned matching map; never infer equivalence from title similarity or transcript text. A prediction may match at most one gold item and vice versa. Count duplicate predictions separately while keeping the TP/FP/FN ledger auditable.
subtasks.testStrategy: Synthetic zero, perfect, one miss, one extra, duplicate, cross-kind, conflicting-map, and order-independence tests with exact ledger assertions.

subtasks.title: Add evidence and policy-sensitive metrics
subtasks.description: Measure evidence attribution, target-speaker responsibility, assignee, due date, and forbidden inference without hiding unavailable denominators.
subtasks.details: For matched outputs only, calculate evidence-utterance attribution accuracy. Report target speaker B Action Item precision/recall/F1 separately. Split assignee and due metrics by explicit, derived proposal, and forbidden inference policy. Preserve unknown, unresolved, and ineligible states instead of coercing them to false or zero. Every metric must expose numerator, denominator, and availability reason.
subtasks.testStrategy: Synthetic mixed-policy fixtures covering empty denominators, partial evidence, organization versus individual assignee, absent due date, relative due date, forbidden attribution, and scorer-ineligible prior state.

subtasks.title: Build per-case diff and aggregate regression report
subtasks.description: Serialize an auditable report that retains each discrepancy before computing aggregate metrics.
subtasks.details: Emit deterministic per-case matched, missed, extra, duplicate, evidence, responsibility, assignee, due, forbidden, ambiguity, and ineligible records, followed by aggregate counts and precision/recall/F1 with numerator and denominator. Do not include transcript text, local absolute paths, credentials, or reviewer notes in the shareable report.
subtasks.testStrategy: Golden synthetic report fixtures, stable sort rules, repeated-run byte identity, privacy-string scans, and aggregate reconciliation against the per-case ledger.

subtasks.title: Wire an explicit fail-closed CLI scoring mode
subtasks.description: Expose scoring only through a deliberate command while keeping the current unscored benchmark path as the default.
subtasks.details: Add a separate CLI mode and output path that requires the scorer authorization contract. Default benchmark execution must remain unscored. Refuse pending gold, unfinished secondary provenance, sealed split without an explicit future sealed authorization, unknown policy versions, and output collisions. Do not add timers, network calls, provider access, or automatic model runs.
subtasks.testStrategy: CLI synthetic success plus refusal tests; verify default commands never read gold; verify existing prediction/report tests remain green and outputs are not overwritten silently.

subtasks.title: Verify, checkpoint, and synchronize the scorer foundation
subtasks.description: Close the engineering slice with proportional verification and a precise handoff to unfinished human gold.
subtasks.details: Run focused synthetic scorer suites, directly affected benchmark suites, Debug app and Benchmark CLI builds, Release/privacy isolation where new test seams exist, and git diff --check. Reconcile all Notion acceptance criteria without claiming a real baseline. Commit and push each coherent implementation checkpoint. Keep actual development scoring, sealed baseline, prompt tuning, PR, merge, tag, release, and publication behind separate approval.
subtasks.testStrategy: Exact pass/fail/skip counts, deterministic report hashes, forbidden-path/read counts, Git ahead/behind, preserved unrelated untracked files, and Notion re-fetch after updates.
